text.arabic_uthmani: ذَٰلِكَ عَٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

words.gloss_range: distal demonstrative that resumes the prior divine description into one identified subject
words.prose: {{ar:ذَٰلِكَ}} ({{tr:dhālika}}) points backward rather than introducing a new subject. Its definiteness and distance gather the divine creation and governance description from 32:4-5 into one elevated referent, then place that referent at the head of a verbless predicate stack: knowing, power, and mercy are presented as stable identity markers rather than as a new narrated event.

topics.headline: backward demonstrative gathers the prior scene
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins by collecting the prior divine creation and governance scene from 32:4-5 into one identified subject.
topics.reason: The demonstrative is definite and distal, and the attachment evidence explicitly points it back to the preceding masculine singular divine referent rather than to an unspecified new noun.

topics.headline: single subject carries three stable predicates
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the clause states an enduring divine portrait through stacked predicates, not a sequence of new actions.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence parse a nominal clause with the demonstrative as subject and three following predicates, supporting identity architecture over event narration.

topics.headline: boundary moves from address to declaration
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a discourse shift from the human reckoning frame in 32:5 into a distanced declaration about the divine subject in 32:6.
topics.reason: The boundary rows cohere with the demonstrative's backward reference: the new ayah summarizes and re-centers the prior material rather than standing alone.

words.gloss_range: active-participle knower predicate in construct with the unseen and witnessed domains
words.root_gloss_range: knowledge, knowing, signs, and worlds; locally the active-participle predicate names intrinsic knowing tied to governed domains
words.prose: {{ar:عَٰلِمُ}} ({{tr:ʿālimu}}) is the first predicate of the demonstrative subject and the head of a construct phrase. Because it governs both the hidden and witnessed domains, the word does not give a loose attribute of awareness; it opens the clause with intrinsic, domain-covering knowledge. The active-participle form keeps the knowing attached to the domains it governs, not to teaching or informing forms, while the root field lets knowing answer the marked worlds-language of 32:2 without changing the local sense. The phrase also joins the repeated divine formula of knowing the unseen (6:73, 9:94, 13:9, 23:92, 39:46, 59:22, 62:8, 64:18), and the nominative reading gives that knowledge independent predicate force against the genitive variant.

topics.headline: construct head begins the predicate stack
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the knowledge title is grammatically bound to its domain while also leading the sequence of divine predicates.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as a masculine singular nominative active participle in construct, and attachment evidence makes it both predicate of the demonstrative and head of the following genitive.

topics.headline: active participle selects intrinsic knowing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the form names the subject as one who knows, not as one who teaches, informs, or merely bears an abstract knowledge label.
topics.reason: The active-participle form supports intrinsic knowing, while broader teaching or informing branches remain contrastive rather than locally selected.

topics.headline: knowledge field reaches signs and worlds
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a background link between knowing, marked signs, and worlds, so the predicate feels suited to the cosmological frame without changing its local sense.
topics.reason: The root field can color the predicate with sign and world associations, but the local surface remains the active participle governing the two knowledge domains.

topics.headline: one predicate governs the hidden and witnessed pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that one knowledge predicate covers the full hidden-witnessed binary instead of making two separate claims.
topics.reason: The construct and coordination attach both domains under the same active participle, and the collocation profile supports the recurring knowledge-domain pairing.

topics.headline: local phrase joins formula and surah echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the local knowledge phrase participates in a repeated divine formula across 6:73, 9:94, 13:9, 23:92, 39:46, 59:22, 62:8, and 64:18 while also answering the worlds-language of 32:2.
topics.reason: The supplied intertext rows give concrete references for the repeated formula and a surah-local root return from 32:2 to 32:6.

topics.headline: standard nominative gives independent predicate force
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the standard case makes knowledge a leading predicate, while the genitive variant shows the alternative pressure toward qualification.
topics.reason: The standard QAC parse is nominative predicate; the variant is useful as contrast but does not override the canonical local parse.

words.gloss_range: the unseen as the first definite genitive domain under the knowing predicate
words.root_gloss_range: absence, hiddenness, disappearance, depth, and what is beyond sight; locally the comprehensive unseen domain
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْغَيْبِ}} ({{tr:al-ghaybi}}) is not a free-standing hidden thing; its genitive case makes it the first governed domain of the knowing predicate. Its definite singular form treats hiddenness as one comprehensive realm, and its pairing with the witnessed domain turns that realm into the first pole of a total knowledge binary repeated at 39:46, 23:92, 13:9, 59:22, 62:8, and 64:18. The depth and disappearance imagery enrich the unseen as what lies beyond normal sight, below sight, or passes from sight, while the local phrase keeps that imagery inside the broader domain sense. The word also answers the faith-in-the-unseen frame of 2:3 and anticipates the hidden-life mystery of 32:9, and its deep opening sound contrasts with the clearer witnessed-domain cadence.

topics.headline: genitive unseen is governed content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the unseen is grammatically the known domain, not a loose theme beside the predicate.
topics.reason: The word is genitive under the construct head, and the attachment evidence marks that relation as syntactically forced.

topics.headline: singular definiteness makes one total unseen realm
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word names the unseen as a comprehensive domain rather than a set of separate hidden items.
topics.reason: The local surface is a definite singular verbal noun; plural-hiddenness evidence sharpens the contrast but does not govern the parse.

topics.headline: hiddenness carries depth and disappearance pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the unseen has spatial and cosmological pressure: beyond sight, below sight, or passed from sight, while still functioning locally as the unseen domain.
topics.reason: Root evidence supports absence, depth, and disappearance images, but local coordination with the witnessed domain selects the broad imperceptible realm rather than a specific well, setting, or social-absence branch.

topics.headline: unseen begins a recurring total-knowledge binary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the unseen and witnessed form a stable merism for total knowledge, attested again in 39:46, 23:92, 13:9, 59:22, 62:8, and 64:18.
topics.reason: The local antonym pair and the repeated co-occurrence data jointly support a comprehensive hidden-witnessed formula.

topics.headline: unseen knowledge answers faith and creation echoes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that what humans are asked to trust in 2:3 is here named as fully known, while 32:9 later places a hidden-life mystery within the same surah arc.
topics.reason: The supplied echo rows give concrete references; they enrich the local unseen domain without replacing the grammatical role under the knowing predicate.

topics.headline: deep opening sound contrasts with witnessed clarity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices an audible contrast that supports the semantic contrast between hidden depth and manifest witnessing.
topics.reason: The phonetic row offers a concrete sound observation that aligns with the local hidden-witnessed opposition.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction that binds the witnessed domain to the unseen under one knowing predicate
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) is the hinge that keeps the witnessed domain inside the same construct-governed knowledge phrase. It does not start a new clause, merely append an afterthought, or reduce the second noun to a secondary circumstance; it coordinates the second domain with the first, making hidden and witnessed distinct poles under one predicate. Its compact prefixal form fuses directly to the second definite noun, so the binary closes quickly and audibly.

topics.headline: conjunction keeps both nouns under one head
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the witnessed domain is co-governed by the same knowing predicate rather than becoming a separate statement.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark the particle as coordination between the two genitives under the construct head.

topics.headline: connector makes two poles one total field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the conjunction preserves two opposite domains while making them together cover the whole field of knowledge.
topics.reason: The joined nouns are established opposites and recurring partners; the conjunction creates a coordinated merism rather than a loose addition.

topics.headline: one-letter prefix binds the second pole
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices how little surface material is needed to fuse the second domain into the first beat.
topics.reason: The particle appears as a single-letter proclitic attached to the following definite noun, giving the relation compact visual and audible form.

topics.headline: primary reading is coordination, not circumstantial aside
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the witnessed domain has equal coordinated status with the unseen, not a secondary even-reading.
topics.reason: The source itself allows a secondary nuance but marks coordination as primary, matching the local conjoined-genitive evidence.

words.gloss_range: the witnessed or manifest domain as the second definite genitive under the knowing predicate
words.root_gloss_range: presence, seeing, witnessing, testimony, evidence, and witnessed scene; locally the manifest domain known by the same predicate
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ}} ({{tr:al-shahādati}}) completes the first beat by adding the manifest, witnessed domain to the unseen. The definite abstract noun turns witnessing into a domain rather than naming a witness or a witnessing act, so the same knowing predicate covers what is present, visible, and attestable as the scene of manifest reality. Its testimony field gives the visible realm evidentiary weight and broadens legal witnessing such as 2:282 into a cosmic register, while the local grammar keeps the word as the second pole of the hidden-witnessed formula found in 6:73, 9:94, 13:9, 23:92, 59:22, 62:8, and 64:18.

topics.headline: second genitive completes the known domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the witnessed realm is directly governed by the knowing predicate, not appended as a separate comment.
topics.reason: The word is genitive and conjoined with the previous genitive under the same construct head.

topics.headline: abstract witnessing becomes a manifest realm
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the form names the domain of what is witnessed, not a witness, a finite act, or an isolated testimony.
topics.reason: The local form is a definite abstract noun, which fits a domain role in balance with the definite unseen noun.

topics.headline: witnessing field adds presence and evidence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the manifest domain carries witness and evidence pressure, while the local phrase does not turn into a legal testimony scene.
topics.reason: The root field includes presence, seeing, testimony, and witness forms; the local genitive abstract noun selects the manifest domain and leaves legal or martyrdom branches as background coloring.

topics.headline: scene derivative makes the visible spatially manifest
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the witnessed domain as the scene of manifest reality, while local grammar keeps it as known content rather than a human observer action.
topics.reason: The derivative scene image supports manifestness, but the local abstract noun names an ontological domain under divine knowledge.

topics.headline: witnessed pole completes recurring totality formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this second pole is required for the recurring hidden-witnessed formula found in 6:73, 9:94, 13:9, 23:92, 59:22, 62:8, and 64:18.
topics.reason: The word is the coordinated counterpart to the unseen in a repeated formula for comprehensive divine knowledge.

topics.headline: testimony echo becomes cosmic
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that legal testimony language such as 2:282 is widened here into the whole manifest realm, with matching definite genitive cadence binding it to the unseen.
topics.reason: The source rows supply both repeated knowledge formulas and a concrete legal-witnessing echo, but the local function is cosmic domain completion.

words.gloss_range: definite nominative divine epithet of unassailable power as the second predicate and first half of the closing pair
words.root_gloss_range: might, inviolability, strength, reinforcement, rarity, and preciousness; locally a stable power epithet paired with mercy
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْعَزِيزُ}} ({{tr:al-ʿazīzu}}) begins the closing attribute pair as a definite nominative predicate. Its form makes power a direct and stable title of the same subject, not a hidden adjective under the knowledge phrase, and the genitive variant exposes how much the standard nominative matters for that predication. The root field gives that power unassailable authority with a shade of irreplaceable preciousness and strengthening capacity, while its immediate pairing with mercy makes the closing formula a governed power, not isolated force. That formula recurs in this order at 26:9, 26:68, 26:104, 26:122, 26:140, 26:159, 26:175, 26:191, 30:5, 36:5, and 44:42; here it chooses mercy rather than the frequent wisdom partner, so the creation-governance unit of 32:4-6 closes on power made merciful rather than tyrannical.

topics.headline: recognized power title is directly predicated
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that power is added as a direct recognized predicate of the same subject, not as a generic quality or subordinate adjective.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as a definite nominative epithet and the attachment evidence makes it another predicate of the demonstrative.

topics.headline: variant exposes predication force
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the standard nominative gives independent predicate force, while the genitive variant would pull the epithet into qualification.
topics.reason: The standard local parse is nominative predicate; variant evidence is useful as contrast for the predicate-versus-qualifier decision.

topics.headline: stable epithet carries unassailable authority
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices power as an enduring attribute of inviolable authority, while eventive strengthening remains only a contrastive branch.
topics.reason: The adjective form supports stable might and inviolability; causative strengthening derivatives color the field but are not the local form.

topics.headline: might includes precious uniqueness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the title can hold irresistible power together with irreplaceable uniqueness, without reducing the local epithet to rarity alone.
topics.reason: The root field supports might, preciousness, and reinforcing capacity; local divine epithet usage selects unassailable power with those shades in the background.

topics.headline: power is locked to mercy in a closing formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that power is paired with mercy in a recognizable order recurring at 26:9, 26:68, 26:104, 26:122, 26:140, 26:159, 26:175, 26:191, 30:5, 36:5, and 44:42.
topics.reason: The two epithets share nominative definiteness locally, and supplied recurrence evidence treats their order as formulaically strong.

topics.headline: local partner turns might toward mercy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this closure chooses mercy as power's partner rather than the frequent wisdom partner, shaping the power as non-tyrannical governance.
topics.reason: The source rows contrast the local mercy pairing with other frequent pairings, while local adjacency gives the modulation its force.

topics.headline: final seal grounds governance in power and mercy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final pair seals the creation-governance unit from 32:4-6 and grounds the prior administration in power joined to mercy.
topics.reason: The boundary and synthesis rows connect the pair to the prior governance action and to the ayah's closing beat.

words.gloss_range: definite nominative mercy epithet as the third predicate and final landing of the ayah
words.root_gloss_range: mercy, compassion, tenderness, kinship, and womb-care imagery; locally enduring divine mercy paired with power
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلرَّحِيمُ}} ({{tr:al-raḥīmu}}) completes the predicate stack and makes mercy the ayah's final word. Its nominative definite form gives mercy direct predicate force beside knowledge and power, and its pattern presents mercy as enduring rather than momentary overflow. The root field brings concrete care, kinship, and nurturing enclosure into the title, while the local pairing with power places mercy inside a governance seal rather than a separate softness. The familiar mercy title from 1:1 is re-partnered here with power, shifting from opening blessing into governance closure; that closure frames the prior administration of 32:5 and anticipates the good-making creation statement in 32:7. Even the final cadence supports the landing: after the stronger power epithet, the ayah ends on mercy's softer audible close.

topics.headline: mercy is directly predicated at the close
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that mercy is a direct final predicate of the same subject, not a subordinate qualification.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as nominative, and attachment evidence makes it another predicate of the demonstrative; the genitive variant only tests the alternative.

topics.headline: mercy is locked to power
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that mercy is the second half of a recurring power-mercy formula, not a generic pleasant ending.
topics.reason: The epithet matches the preceding power epithet in definiteness and nominative case, and the pair is strongly recurrent in the supplied data.

topics.headline: form selects durable mercy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices mercy as an enduring attribute at the close, while overflow-intensity forms remain contrastive.
topics.reason: The local epithet form supports durable mercy; comparison with other mercy forms clarifies the choice without substituting another form.

topics.headline: mercy carries concrete nurturing pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that mercy is colored by care, kinship, and nurturing enclosure, while the local title remains a divine attribute rather than a biological noun.
topics.reason: The root field supports womb and kinship imagery, but the local surface is the definite mercy epithet.

topics.headline: mercy is possessed, not requested
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word names the subject as merciful rather than depicting someone seeking mercy or adding mercy as an abstract object.
topics.reason: The local adjectival epithet blocks a seeking-mercy frame and differs from an abstract mercy noun.

topics.headline: familiar mercy is re-partnered with power
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that mercy familiar from 1:1 is here paired with power, shifting the emphasis from opening blessing to governance closure.
topics.reason: The source rows explicitly contrast the 1:1 pairing with the local power pairing and support a contextual shift without changing the mercy sense.

topics.headline: final word lands on mercy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that after knowledge and power, the ayah's last audible and structural landing is mercy.
topics.reason: The word is clause-final, and the synthesis row ties its root image to terminal placement.

topics.headline: mercy carries governance into creation goodness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the mercy closure frames the prior administration from 32:5 and anticipates the good-making creation statement in 32:7.
topics.reason: Boundary rows connect the final epithet backward to governance and forward to the next creation statement.

topics.headline: sound softens the final landing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the closing cadence supports the semantic landing on mercy after the stronger power epithet.
topics.reason: The phonetic row supplies a concrete final cadence observation that aligns with the terminal mercy topic.

baseline_models.mechanism: Knowing is disclosure across one visibility continuum: one pole is screened from eyes and the other is present to observation.

activation_trace.role: Uncovering a thing to its knower supplies access across both poles.
Screening from eyes supplies the concealed pole of the continuum.
Presence with observation supplies the manifest pole of the continuum.

changed_reading.before: A title stating knowledge of two separate categories.
changed_reading.after: A single knowing crosses and governs the boundary between screened and present reality.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence عَٰلِمُ ... ٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ at words 2-6
baseline_models.mechanism: A mark makes reality inferable, informed testimony states it, might makes the testimony effective, and mercy directs its use; the titles can form an evidence-to-action chain.

activation_trace.role: A distinguishing mark that guides to its object makes knowing trace-based.
Clear statement grounded in knowledge converts recognition into testimony.
Prevailing force gives the informed testimony practical consequence.
Tender beneficence supplies the humane direction of effective power.

changed_reading.before: Four adjacent descriptions of knowledge, visibility, power, and mercy.
changed_reading.after: An evidentiary process moves from marks to testimony and then to force made beneficent.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The closing pair ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ at words 5-6
baseline_models.mechanism: Strength and reinforcement give mercy the capacity to act, while tenderness and kin relation give strength a relational end.

activation_trace.role: Strength and invulnerability supply the efficacy of the closing pair.
Reinforcing one by another makes power enabling rather than merely dominant.
Tenderness and beneficence orient that efficacy toward care.
Kinship makes mercy a binding relation rather than a passing emotion.

changed_reading.before: Might and mercy are contrasting traits held side by side.
changed_reading.after: The pair is a coupled capacity: mercy can accomplish its end because it is strong, and strength is relationally directed.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ٱلْغَيْبِ, ٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ, and ٱلرَّحِيمُ at words 3, 4, and 6
baseline_models.mechanism: Hidden roots and the womb hold developing life until an emergence associated with birth becomes witnessed; unseen and witnessed can therefore name phases of generation.

activation_trace.role: Roots concealed underground supply latent growth before appearance.
What emerges with birth supplies a bodily threshold into witness.
The womb supplies the protected container in which hidden formation occurs.

changed_reading.before: Unseen and witnessed are static epistemic regions.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they are successive states in a protected process of formation and emergence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Descent carries a hidden source into an ordered inscription whose marks can become informed testimony; negated doubt makes the focus knowledge an authentication mechanism, not only total awareness.

activation_trace.role: Concealment supplies the source side of revelation's visibility transfer.
Knowledge-based declaration supplies the testable witness side of the transfer.
Sending something down and delivering it supplies movement from source to recipient.
Ordered letters and the written object give the delivered content a manifest form.
An inscription that establishes judgment makes manifestation consequential.
Disturbance of doubt supplies the epistemic condition explicitly negated.
A distinguishing mark lets the worlds function as readable evidence within the transfer.

structural_cues: 32:2 sequences descent, book, negated doubt, and worlds; 32:3 then opposes fabrication to truth before the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies delivery, inscription, doubt, and mark images; I infer a transfer from hidden source into testable witness. Alternatively, the sequence may authenticate the book without redefining the focus pair.

changed_reading.before: The Knower spans hidden and visible reality in the abstract.
changed_reading.after: The Knower also guarantees a route by which hidden source becomes inscribed, readable, and answerable as witness.

context_deltas.mechanism: Knowledge operates as calibrated administration: an affair is managed by its consequences, moves through a descending and ascending circuit, and is held to measure; might sustains the circuit and mercy qualifies its governance.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to the knower supplies complete oversight of the circuit.
Reinforcement supplies the capacity that keeps administration effective.
Beneficent tenderness supplies the governing orientation of that capacity.
Managing an affair by looking to its outcome supplies the controlling operation.
The affair or state supplies what is being administered.
Ascent supplies the returning half of the vertical circuit.
Measured planning supplies calibration across the circuit's scale.

structural_cues: 32:5 moves the affair from sky to earth and back upward, then 32:6 begins with the deictic ذَٰلِكَ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies management, ascent, and measure; I take the deictic focus as gathering that prior operation under its attributes. Alternatively, ذَٰلِكَ may point more broadly to the creator described across 32:4-5.

changed_reading.before: Knowledge, might, and mercy are possessions of the named subject.
changed_reading.after: They are operating properties of a measured, bidirectional administration joining remote and present domains.

context_deltas.mechanism: An extracted fluid enters concealed formation, receives breath and life, and emerges with faculties of witness; the context enacts the focus's exploratory gestational threshold.

activation_trace.role: Underground hidden roots supply the image of latent organic formation.
Emergence associated with birth supplies transition into embodied witness.
The womb supplies the protected site of concealed development.
An extracted substance supplies the selected material entering development.
Male fluid in the womb supplies the context's concealed generative material.
Sending air into something supplies the transition from shaped matter toward animation.
The life-bearing spirit supplies animation of the formed body.
Eyesight supplies a faculty by which the emerged being enters witness.

structural_cues: 32:7-9 orders clay, extracted fluid, shaping, breath, and hearing-sight-heart faculties.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a developmental sequence and bodily branch images; I align its concealed and perceptive phases with the focus pair. Alternatively, the sequence may exemplify creation without making الغيب and الشهادة developmental terms.

changed_reading.before: The gestational baseline is an odd possibility internal to the focus branches.
changed_reading.after: The following creation sequence gives that possibility a visible mechanism from concealed material to a perceiving witness.

context_deltas.mechanism: Dissolution and death move the creature out of ordinary visibility, but return reverses that concealment into sight, hearing, and certainty; knowledge spans the whole reversible threshold while might enforces it.

activation_trace.role: Burial supplies the concrete concealment boundary crossed by death.
Presence with observation supplies the restored state of witness.
Death overpowering a person supplies force at the threshold.
Disappearance into hiddenness supplies the speakers' model of dissolution in earth.
Loss of life and force supplies passage out of ordinary witness.
Return to a former point supplies reversal of the concealment trajectory.
Visual seeing supplies the restored evidentiary condition.
Hearing supplies a second restored channel of witness.
Stable knowledge without doubt supplies the result of restored witness.

structural_cues: 32:10 denies new creation after being lost in earth; 32:11 answers with death and return; 32:12 stages sight, hearing, and certainty.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealment, death, return, and restored senses; I infer one reversible visibility mechanism under the focus attributes. Alternatively, the three ayat may be sequential rebuttal rather than a model of the focus pair.

changed_reading.before: Unseen and witnessed are coexisting domains known at once.
changed_reading.after: They are also states traversed through death and compelled return, with witness recovered after apparent loss.

context_deltas.mechanism: Might and mercy become lived as fear and hope, bending the body downward and drawing it from rest; the response is met by recompense deliberately concealed from creaturely knowledge, making unseen mercy a protected reserve.

activation_trace.role: Strength and invulnerability supply the pole that can awaken fear.
Tender beneficence supplies the pole that can sustain hope.
Concealment from eyes supplies the protected reserve of recompense.
Bodily lowering supplies the enacted response to the paired attributes.
Fear expecting harm supplies one explicit affective orientation.
The heart's hope supplies the complementary affective orientation.
Disclosure to a knower is denied to the creature, marking an epistemic asymmetry.
Deliberate concealment supplies safekeeping of what is prepared.
Answering an act with its recompense supplies the concealed reserve's purpose.

structural_cues: 32:16 pairs fear and hope; 32:17 immediately says no soul knows what has been hidden as recompense.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies paired affects and hidden recompense; I map might toward fear and mercy toward hope, then read concealment as protective. The live alternative is that fear and hope address the Lord generally and do not divide neatly across the two attributes.

changed_reading.before: Might and mercy describe the subject while unseen knowledge remains remote.
changed_reading.after: The pair generates a fear-hope posture, and unseen knowledge holds a merciful gift beyond the responder's present access.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing attributes become an architecture of unequal outcomes: mercy appears as compassionate refuge and prepared hospitality, while might appears as inescapable return and severe experience; the nearer severity may still interrupt a course and open return.

activation_trace.role: Severe impact supplies the forceful side of unequal containment.
Compassionate beneficence supplies the hospitable side of containment.
Equality between two parties supplies the relation explicitly denied.
Tender mercy toward one sheltered makes refuge an enacted form of care.
Provisions prepared for an arriving guest make the refuge hospitable.
Attempted passage outside supplies the escape vector that is blocked.
Return after departure supplies the coercive loop of confinement.
Experiential tasting makes nearer severity embodied feedback.
Painful punishment supplies the severe feedback at both contrasted scales.
Turning back from an affair supplies the possible corrective endpoint.

structural_cues: 32:18 denies equality, 32:19 offers refuge and hospitality, 32:20 repeats failed exit and return, and 32:21 places nearer pain before hoped return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed shelters, a forced-return loop, and nearer pain followed by possible return; I read them as spatial and corrective expressions of mercy and might. Alternatively, the nearer pain may only warn and not function remedially.

changed_reading.before: Might and mercy are balanced qualities without an enacted topology.
changed_reading.after: They organize asymmetric spaces of welcome and confinement, with severity remaining potentially corrective before final closure.

context_deltas.mechanism: Marks are recalled and presented, refusal turns away from them, punishment follows denial, and judgment finally separates divergent paths; knowing and witness thus form a forensic process backed by prevailing authority.

activation_trace.role: A mark guiding to its object supplies the case's evidentiary substrate.
A declaration grounded in knowledge supplies formal testimony.
Prevailing force supplies enforceability after judgment.
Calling something back after lapse re-presents known material for response.
A manifest sign supplies evidence offered to the respondent.
Turning one's side away supplies refusal of the presented evidence.
Punishment after rejection supplies consequence following refusal.
Judgment separating truth from falsehood supplies adjudication.
Separation supplies the visible boundary produced by adjudication.
Parties taking divergent paths supplies the dispute to be resolved.

structural_cues: 32:22 orders reminder, signs, turning away, and retribution; 32:25 later places final separation amid disagreement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies signs, refusal, consequence, divergence, and judgment; I join them into one evidentiary process under the focus titles. Alternatively, the scenes may be distinct moral episodes rather than stages of one case.

changed_reading.before: Knowledge of witness means awareness of what is openly present.
changed_reading.after: Witness becomes admissible sign and testimony within a process that can distinguish, judge, and enforce.

context_deltas.mechanism: Present dwellings and movement through them let surviving traces testify to generations no longer present; marks bridge hidden history and current witness without making the past directly visible.

activation_trace.role: A distinguishing trace that guides to its absent object supplies inferential knowing.
Absence from eyes supplies the status of destroyed generations.
A sign that indicates a condition lets remains function as witness.
Falling into extinction supplies the historical agents' absence.
Current walking supplies bodily contact with the surviving scene.
A place of settlement supplies the durable trace left after its occupants.
A manifest sign names the evidentiary function of those remains.
Hearing supplies the present audience's channel for receiving the traced history.

structural_cues: 32:26 places current walkers in the dwellings of destroyed earlier generations and then calls the scene signs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies extinct generations, inhabited places, walking, signs, and hearing; I infer that surviving places testify to absent history. Alternatively, the dwellings may function only as warning examples, not as a theory of witness.

changed_reading.before: The unseen is inaccessible and witness is what an observer directly encounters.
changed_reading.after: Visible traces can witness to absent histories, so knowing bridges the pair through material inference.

context_deltas.mechanism: Driven water enters vegetation-cut land, enables concealed roots to grow, brings crop out of hiddenness, and ends in sight; might supplies traction through resistant matter while womb-like mercy supplies nurture.

activation_trace.role: Roots hidden underground supply the latent stage of ecological growth.
A condition-indicating sign supplies the visible crop's evidentiary role.
Hard, cohesive ground supplies the resistance through which power operates.
The womb as a growth vessel supplies the land's nurturing analogy.
Driving something onward supplies forceful delivery of water.
Conveying water by irrigation supplies the nurturing input.
Land cut off from vegetation supplies the resistant starting condition.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies the hidden-to-manifest transition.
Causing crop to grow supplies the transformation's living product.
Eyesight supplies the final reception of the manifested sign.

structural_cues: 32:27 orders driven water, barren land, emergence, crop, consumption, and a closing appeal to sight.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies water delivery, barren resistance, emergence, growth, and sight; I align them with hidden roots, witness-sign, hard ground, and womb branches in the focus. Alternatively, this may be one analogy for resurrection rather than a general ecological reading of the attributes.

changed_reading.before: The focus attributes remain abstract epistemic and moral predicates.
changed_reading.after: They can be read as an ecological action grammar in which force delivers, mercy nurtures, hidden growth emerges, and the result testifies.

context_deltas.mechanism: The hidden future becomes witnessed through an opening that is also judgment; before that threshold there is waiting, but after it benefit and respite close, so inaccessibility and mercy acquire temporal rather than merely qualitative force.

activation_trace.role: What is screened from eyes supplies the not-yet-visible future phase.
Presence with observation supplies the phase after the event opens.
Rarity and difficulty of access supply the threshold's pre-event inaccessibility.
Beneficence supplies a possible reading of the interval still left before closure.
Opening a closure supplies transition from hidden future to present event.
Opening by decisive judgment makes the transition legally final.
Benefit opposed to harm supplies the capacity explicitly lost after opening.
Granting delay supplies the respite explicitly denied at the threshold.
Turning aside supplies the instructed posture during the remaining interval.
Mutual waiting supplies the unresolved time before manifestation.

structural_cues: 32:28 asks when the opening comes, 32:29 removes benefit and respite on its day, and 32:30 closes with reciprocal waiting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opening, judgment, lost benefit, denied delay, and waiting; I infer a temporal conversion of الغيب into الشهادة and tentatively treat the pre-opening interval as merciful opportunity. Alternatively, waiting may be procedural rather than merciful.

strongest_changes: The hidden-witnessed pair became a traversable boundary enacted by revelation, birth, death-return, historical inference, and ecological emergence.
Might and mercy became coupled operating capacities rather than contrasting adjectives: they administer, orient fear and hope, shelter, constrain, and sometimes correct.
Witness expanded from direct visibility to inscriptions, signs, testimony, surviving dwellings, and manifested growth.
The final opening made hidden and witnessed temporally successive states with an irreversible threshold.
summary.what_was_special: The packet repeatedly activated mechanisms of concealment becoming evidence without collapsing all readings into one: epistemic, judicial, gestational, affective, spatial, historical, ecological, and temporal models remain simultaneously live.
remaining_uncertainties: The deictic ذَٰلِكَ may gather the immediately preceding administration or the broader creator description.
Mappings from might to fear and mercy to hope or corrective pain are coherent directional inferences, not supplied one-to-one by the packet.
Reservoir, tunnel, absent-speech, and gestational activations are intentionally branch-distant and require explicit exploratory qualification.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Knowledge spans latent process and manifest result.** `غ ي ب:B001` is what is hidden from sight or human knowledge; `ش ه د:B001` is presence with direct witnessing, and `ع ل م:B001` is apprehension as a thing becomes clear. In 32:7–9, clay, extracted fluid, formation, spirit, hearing, sight, and hearts unfold from material origin to perceptible human capacities. **Inferred arrow:** access to both concealed antecedents and witnessed outcomes -> knowledge of the whole transformation. The pair *al-ghayb wa-l-shahāda* thus reads dynamically across stages of formation, not merely as two static territories.

2. **Burial is a concrete edge case of the unseen.** Exploratorily, `غ ي ب:B009` supplies hiding by burial, while `غ ي ب:B002` supplies a low place in which something disappears. Within this ayah’s forward window, 32:10 imagines bodies lost in the earth and 32:11 names death and return. The packet supplies disappearance in earth; **the inferred arrow is:** terrestrial concealment -> a physical instance within the knower’s unseen domain. The epithet anticipatorily answers the resurrection objection: becoming hidden in earth does not become hidden from this knowledge.

3. **Might and mercy are complementary capacities.** `ع ز ز:B001` gives might, invulnerability, and honor; `ر ح م:B001` gives mercy and beneficence. The fragile origins and bestowed senses of 32:7–9 activate beneficence, while dissolution in 32:10 and the delegated taking and return of 32:11 activate irresistible control. **Inferred arrow:** beneficent formation + unconstrained recovery -> one continuous power over origin and return. The closing attributes read as functionally paired rather than affectively opposed.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 32:11 supplied a concrete bridge between hidden and witnessed domains: what appears as death is a complete receipt (`و ف ي:B002`) executed by an assigned agent. This sharpened 32:6's knowledge claim into active custody across an otherwise hidden transition, with might and mercy governing the same passage.

findings.text: Görünmeyen ile görünenin birlikte bilinmesi, gizli başlangıçlardan gözlemlenen sonuçlara kadar bütün dönüşüm aşamalarını tek bir bilgi alanında toplar.

Eşin hazır olması ve ibadet yerleri gibi örnekler çekirdek anlamı genişletir; sözlü tanıklık veya bal anlamı bu dalın sınırına girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak hazır bulunma ve görme çekirdeğini verir; hac yeri ve eşi yanında olan kadın gibi kullanımlar yapıya bağlı özel yüzlerdir.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişi ya da şeyin bir yerde hazır bulunması ve çoğu bağlamda olayı doğrudan görerek deneyimlemesidir. Bu çekirdekten, insanların bulunduğu yer, belli ibadet yerleri ve yanında eşi bulunan kadın gibi bağlı kullanımlar doğar.

facets.statement: Bir olayın ya da yerin yanında hazır bulunma ve onu doğrudan görme çekirdeği vardır.
İnsanların bulunduğu ya da toplandığı yer, bu hazır bulunma çekirdeğinin yer adı olarak uzantısıdır.
Hac törenlerinin yapıldığı yerler, bulunulan ibadet mahalleri olarak özel bir kullanımdır.
Eşi yanında bulunan kadın kullanımı, hazır bulunma ilişkisinin aile içi duruma uygulanmasıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Toprak adı yalın bir zemin türünü, eylem biçimleri ise kumun, etin veya toprağın sertleşip sıkılaşmasını bildirir; kapsamlar harmanlanmaz.

Hazırlanan dal çerçevesi bu duygusal yönü, eylem sonucunu, karşılıklı kullanımları ve Tanrı'ya ilişkin genişletmeyi aynı ana bağ içinde doğru biçimde toplar.

concept_map.definition: Bir başkasına karşı yüreğin yumuşaması, ona acıma ve bu yönelişin onu esirgeyip ona iyilik etmeyi gerektirmesidir. Tanrı'ya uygulandığında insandaki duygulanmadan çok, kuşatıcı esirgeme ve iyilik sonucu öne çıkar.

facets.statement: Bir başkasının durumu karşısında yüreğin yumuşaması, ona acıma ve içten yakınlık duyma çekirdeği oluşturur.
Bu iç yöneliş, acınan kişiyi esirgemeyi ve ona iyilikte bulunmayı gerektiren etkin bir sonuç taşır.
Topluluğun bireylerinin birbirine acıyıp birbirini esirgemesi, çekirdeğin karşılıklı bir kuruluşta gerçekleşmesidir.
Bir kimsenin Tanrı'nın esirgemesine erişmesini dilemek, çekirdek anlamdan doğan kalıplaşmış bir söz eylemidir.
Tanrı hakkında kullanıldığında esirgemenin genişliği ve yaratılmışlara iyilik olarak ulaşması belirginleşir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili kaynak anlatımı, ortak soydan gelmeye dayanan yakın ilişkiyi dalın çekirdeği olarak verir ve organ adının ortak doğum kaynağı düşüncesiyle bu ilişkiye aktarıldığını açıklar. Hazırlanan çerçeve, bedensel organı bu daldan ayırırken soy bağını, çoğul bağları ve bu bağın sürdürülüp koparılmasını doğru yerde tutar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, bedensel organı değil ortak soydan doğan yakın ilişkiyi anlatır; bağı sürdürme ya da koparma eylemleri ancak ilgili kalıplarda bu çekirdeğe eklenir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın biçimler yakın soy bağını adlandırır; bu bağı sürdürme veya koparma anlamı ise yalnızca eylem kalıbına bağlıdır ve yalın dal tanımına katılmaz.

concept_map.definition: İnsanları ortak bir soydan gelmeleri yoluyla birbirine bağlayan yakın ilişkidir. Organ adı, birden çok kişinin aynı doğum kaynağından çıkması düşüncesiyle bu toplumsal bağa aktarılmıştır.

facets.statement: Ortak soydan gelme, kişiler arasında yakın ve kalıcı bir soy ilişkisi kurar.
Bedensel organın adı, aynı doğum kaynağından çıkmış olma düşüncesi üzerinden soy ilişkisine aktarılmıştır.
Soy bağını sürdürmek veya koparmak, ilişkinin kendisini değil ona karşı takınılan eylemli tutumu anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım, aynı atadan ya da yakın bir soy çizgisinden gelen kişileri birbirine bağlayan ilişkiyi öne çıkarır. Çoğul kullanım bu bağların ve soy yollarının bütününü, eylemli kullanım ise bağın sürdürülmesini veya kesilmesini bildirir; organla bağlantı ortak doğum kaynağına dayanan bir aktarımdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Hazırlanan başlık doğumdan sonraki ağrıyı doğru bir merkez olarak gösterse de yetkili kaynak anlatımı bundan daha geniştir: dişi deve, koyun veya kadında döl yatağının ağrıması ya da hastalanması yanında şişme ve koyunun doğumdan sonra yavru zarını atamaması da aynı dalda yer alır. Dal bölünmeden korunabilir, fakat tanım yalnızca doğum sonrası ağrıyla sınırlandırılmamalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal sağlıklı organı veya genel beden ağrısını değil, döl yatağına özgü ağrı, hastalık, şişme ve doğum sonrası yavru zarını atamama durumlarını kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Verilen biçimler döl yatağına özgü hastalık ve doğum sonrası bozuklukları bağımsız olarak adlandırır; tanım başka bir kalıptan yalın anlama aktarım yapmaz.

concept_map.definition: Dişi deve, koyun veya kadında döl yatağının ağrıması ya da hastalanmasıyla; koyunda ise ayrıca şişmesiyle belirlenen durumdur. Bazı kullanımlar bunu doğum sonrasına bağlar. Koyunun doğumdan sonra yavru zarını atamaması da bu organ çevresindeki özel bir bozukluk olarak dala dahildir.

facets.statement: Dişi hayvan veya kadında döl yatağının ağrıması ya da hastalanması temel durumdur; özellikle bazı kullanımlarda bu durum doğum sonrasında görülür.
Koyunun doğum yaptıktan sonra yavru zarını dışarı atamaması, dala bağlı özel bir doğum sonrası bozukluktur.
Koyun veya koyun sürüsünde döl yatağının şişmesi, hastalık durumunun özel bir gerçekleşmesidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım, dişi deve, koyun veya kadının döl yatağında ağrı ya da hastalık bulunmasını temel alır. Kaynakların bir bölümü bunu özellikle doğum sonrasına bağlar. Toplu anlatım ayrıca koyunda organın şişmesini ve doğumdan sonra yavru zarının atılamamasını aynı organ çevresindeki özel durumlar olarak kaydeder.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, döl yatağının ağrı, hastalık, şişme veya doğum sonrası bozukluk içindeki durumunu adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, herhangi bir hastalık şartı olmadan yavruyu taşıyan sağlıklı organın kendisini adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal aynı bedensel organa dayanır ve biri ötekinin hastalık durumunu anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal anatomik yapının adıdır; odak ise o yapıda ortaya çıkan belirli patolojik ve doğum sonrası durumların adıdır. Organın varlığı hastalık bulunduğunu göstermez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak, döl yatağı ağrısı, hastalığı, şişmesi ve doğum sonrası bozukluklarla sınırlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu, meme, boğaz veya sırttaki şişkinliği ve doğum sırasında memenin sütle dolup sarkmasını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: döl yatağı bozukluğu ile başka şişmeler
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal dişi hayvanlarda doğum çevresinde görülebilen şişme ve bedensel değişiklikleri konu edinir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odakta etkilenen yer döl yatağıdır ve durum hastalık olarak ele alınır. Komşu farklı beden bölgelerindeki şişmeyi ve olağan süt verme değişimini de kapsadığı için yalnızca aynı hayvancılık ve beden alanını paylaşır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak, dişi üreme organına ve çoğunlukla doğum sonrasına bağlı bir hastalık kümesidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu, koyun ve keçinin bel, böğür, kalça veya bacak bölgelerini etkileyip yürüyüşü bozan başka bir hastalıktır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: üreme organı hastalığı ile başka hayvan hastalığı
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal koyunlarda görülen, ağrı veya belirgin beden bozukluğu yapan hayvan hastalıklarını adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Ortak alan hayvan hastalığıdır; etkilenen organ, belirtiler ve doğumla bağlantı bütünüyle farklıdır. Bu nedenle alan ortaklığı dışında anlam örtüşmesi yoktur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak, yalnızca dişi üreme organındaki hastalık ve doğum sonrası bozuklukları kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu, insan veya hayvanda böğür ve yan bölgesindeki hastalık, susuzluk etkisi veya darbe sonucunu kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: döl yatağı ağrısı ile yan ağrısı
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal bedendeki belirli bir bölgeye yerleşen ağrı veya hastalığı adlandırma alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Etkilenen beden bölgesi ve hastalığın oluşma bağlamı farklıdır. Odak doğum ve dişi üreme organıyla sınırlıyken komşu yan bölgesine ve başka nedenlere bağlıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak, döl yatağına özgü ağrı ve doğum sonrası bozuklukları bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu, boğazda veya küçük dil yakınında ortaya çıkan ağrılı hastalığı bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: üreme organı ağrısı ile boğaz ağrısı
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal, etkilenen beden bölümüne göre adlandırılmış yerel bir ağrı veya hastalık durumudur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Benzerlik yalnızca beden bölgesine bağlı hastalık adı olmalarıdır. Organ, hasta grubu ve doğumla ilişki farklı olduğundan anlamları birbirinin yerine geçmez.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Sunulan bütün adaylar değerlendirildi. Sağlıklı organla ayrım ilk sıraya alındı; hayvanlarda şişme ve üç farklı yerel hastalık dalı alan sınırını gösterdi.
